title: Why Lottery Winners Go Broke
hook_text: WINNING THE LOTTERY DOESN'T MAKE YOU RICH

beats.say: Winning the lottery doesn't make you rich, it just makes you poor with better stuff.
beats.visual: A silhouette of a person holding a blank white ticket in a dim room with dramatic window light, cinematic

beats.say: In 2011, researchers studied Florida lottery winners who scored between $50,000 and $2,000,000.
beats.visual: A close-up of a stack of old academic papers on a dark wooden table, dusty lighting

beats.say: They tracked their bank accounts for years to see what happened after the confetti cleared.
beats.visual: A vintage desk calendar flipped halfway, shot from a high angle, moody shadows

beats.say: The data revealed a harsh truth that surprises almost everyone who dreams of a jackpot.
beats.visual: A close-up of a fountain pen resting on a blank ledger, cinematic shallow depth of field

beats.say: Bankruptcy rates among winners didn't fall long-term. In fact, they spiked after just 3 years.
beats.visual: A glowing desk lamp in an otherwise dark home office, empty chair, moody atmosphere

beats.say: But here's the part nobody mentions about sudden money.
beats.visual: A blurred shot of a city street at night through rain-streaked glass, cinematic purple and gold tones

beats.say: More cash doesn't fix broken habits. It just puts a megaphone to them.
beats.visual: A hand closing a leather wallet on a dark counter, sharp focus, moody lighting

beats.say: Without a system, a windfall acts like water poured into a bucket with holes.
beats.visual: An old metal bucket sitting on cracked concrete in warm afternoon sunlight, realistic textures

beats.say: Wealth isn't about the size of the check you deposit.
beats.visual: A minimalist wooden desk with a single blank notepad and a modern pen, side lighting

beats.say: It's about the boring systems you build to keep it.
beats.visual: A person's hands locking a small steel safety box on a dark wooden table, macro lens

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you, because...
beats.visual: A closed heavy wooden door with light shining underneath from a hallway, cinematic framing

caption: Sudden money without systems always leaks out. Here's what the data actually says about windfalls. #moneypolicy #personalfinance #wealthmindset #financialfreedom #smartmoney
description: A 2011 study of Florida lottery winners revealed that bankruptcy rates didn't fall long-term. Windfalls require systems, not just cash.
first_comment: Would you take the lump sum or annual payments if you won?

facts.claim: A 2011 study of Florida lottery winners found bankruptcy rates did not fall long-term
facts.basis: Published economic research on Florida lottery winners and bankruptcy filings.
